name: Template Experiment (Synthetic, Abstract)
description: A template for creating synthetic experiments. Serves as a blueprint demonstrating how to structure experiments with configurable parameters, variable definitions, simulation functions with noise capability, and visualization tools.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Experimental conditions specifying independent variable values.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: Simulated dependent variable values from the template experiment.
